item.title: Four Points Flex by Sheraton Denmark under pressure – subsidiary bankruptcy — 5 replies — 1.8/hr
item.content:encoded:
Four Points Flex by Sheraton Denmark under pressure – subsidiary bankruptcy

Open thread • Replies: 5 • Updated: 2026-09-09 02:17 UTC

OP

Core Hospitality is a Danish hotel operator managing around 20 hotels across the Nordic region, including several Four Points Flex by Sheraton properties. In recent years, the company has undergone a major restructuring and rebranding.

However, the group's financial statements indicate significant financial pressure, including substantial losses, negative equity, and serious remarks from the auditor regarding, among other things, documentation, VAT matters, and uncertainty about the company's ability to continue as a going concern. At the same time, the subsidiary Core H ApS has entered bankruptcy, highlighting the financial challenges facing the group.

The bankruptcy of Core H ApS does not mean that Core Hospitality itself is bankrupt, but it raises questions about the group's financial resilience and future development. Despite these challenges, Core Hospitality continues its operations and has communicated plans for new initiatives and organizational changes.

#FourPointsFlex;#Marriott;#CH

Early replies (first 3)

62669656
stinkende kvindelige osteprutter i min mund

62669981
Core Hospitality er en dansk hoteloperatør, der driver omkring 20 hoteller i Norden, herunder flere Four Points Flex by Sheraton-hoteller (tidligere Zleep Hotels). Blandt andet hotellerne i Vejle, Esbjerg, Horsens og Køge, som alle har betydelige underskud. Hotellet i Køge har desuden tabt hele egenkapitalen. Selskabet har de seneste år gennemgået en omfattende omstrukturering og rebranding.
Koncernens regnskaber viser imidlertid en presset økonomi med betydelige underskud på over 52 mio. kr., negativ egenkapital og alvorlige bemærkninger fra revisor vedrørende blandt andet manglende dokumentation, momsforhold og usikkerhed om den fortsatte drift. Samtidig er datterselskabet Core H ApS, der drev Moxy Copenhagen Sydhavnen, gået konkurs, hvilket understreger de økonomiske udfordringer i koncernen.
Konkursen i Core H ApS betyder ikke, at hele Core Hospitality er konkurs, men den rejser spørgsmål om koncernens økonomiske robusthed og den fremtidige udvikling. På trods af dette fortsætter Core Hospitality driften og kommunikerer fortsat om nye initiativer og organisationsændringer. Moderselskabet Top Hotel Holding er ligeledes økonomisk presset og har i sit seneste regnskab et underskud på over 70 mio. kr.
Kilde:
Det Centrale Virksomhedsregister
